title: Pure C Series
summary: The "C" Series of EARTH Insect handtraps and field-swarmers paired with Giant Ballpark, Gokipole, Resonance Insect, and Insect Extra Deck bosses. By punishing every opposing Special Summon from the hand while flooding the board with Shiny Black "C" Squadder via Giant Ballpark, the deck combines reactive floodgates with an Insect Link/Xyz engine.

summary.title: Starters & Insect Search Engine
points: Gokipole searches any Level 4 Insect when sent to the GY; adding the Normal Monster Shiny Black "C" Squadder lets you immediately Special Summon it from the hand and destroy a monster on the field with equal or higher ATK.

Resonance Insect searches any Level 5 or higher Insect (Super Armored Robot Armed Black Iron "C" or Confronting the "C") when sent from the field to the GY, and sends Gokipole or Retaliating "C" from the Deck to the GY when banished.
Retaliating "C" searches any EARTH Insect with 1500 or less ATK (Contact "C", Flying "C", Sneaky "C", Gokipole, or Resonance Insect) whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.

Giant Ballpark (searched by Terraforming) negates battle damage once per turn to send a Level 4 or lower Insect from the Deck to the GY and Special Summon up to 3 copies of Shiny Black "C" Squadder from your hand, Deck, and/or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Any Two Insects into Inzektor Picofalena
steps: Summon two Insects (or trigger Giant Ballpark in battle to summon 3 copies of Shiny Black "C" Squadder) and Link Summon Inzektor Picofalena.
Discard 1 card with Picofalena to equip Gokipole or Retaliating "C" from the Deck to another Insect you control.

Link Summon Seraphim Papillion using Picofalena and the equipped Insect; Gokipole or Retaliating "C" hits the GY and triggers to search Contact "C", Retaliating "C", or Shiny Black "C" Squadder (with Gokipole popping a monster if it adds Squadder).

summary.title: The "C" Handtrap Suite
summary.text: Each "C" monster punishes a different Special Summon mechanic from the hand. Retaliating "C" Special Summons itself when the opponent activates a Spell that includes a Special Summon effect and banishes any card sent to the GY while face-up. Contact "C" Special Summons itself to the opponent's field when they Normal or Special Summon, locking them out of Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Summons unless they use Contact "C" as material. Flying "C" summons itself to the opponent's field when they Special Summon to completely prevent them from Xyz Summoning, and Sneaky "C" summons itself face-down when they Special Summon to destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field during the End Phase.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Super Armored Robot Armed Black Iron "C" Special Summons itself from the hand by banishing 3 Insects with the same name from your GY (such as 3 Shiny Black "C" Squadders), equips an Insect from the GY, and sends the equip to the GY to destroy all opposing monsters with equal or higher ATK.
Confronting the "C" Special Summons itself when the opponent Special Summons from the Extra Deck and is unaffected by monster effects that target it.
Seraphim Papillion gains counters for each Insect used as Link Material and removes a counter as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to revive a Level 4 or lower "C" Insect in Defense Position.
Number 3: Cicada King (Rank 3 from Level 3 "C" monsters and Gokipole) detaches a material to negate an opposing monster's effects.

allow.Resonance Insect: Searches high-level Insects when sent to GY and dumps Gokipole when banished via Retaliating "C".
allow.Gokipole: Searches Shiny Black "C" Squadder or Retaliating "C" when sent to the GY, and destroys an opponent's monster if it searches a Normal Monster.
allow.Giant Ballpark: Field Spell that negates battle damage to send and summon up to 3 copies of Shiny Black "C" Squadder from Deck/GY.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Giant Ballpark Field Spell.
allow.Inzektor Picofalena: Link-2 Insect that equips Gokipole or Retaliating "C" from the Deck to trigger their GY search effects.
allow.Seraphim Papillion: Link-3 Insect boss that revives Level 4 or lower "C" Insects as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 3: Cicada King: Rank 3 Insect Xyz accessible via Level 3 "C" monsters that negates monster effects and revives Insects.

Flying "C"

Sneaky "C"

Super Armored Robot Armed Black Iron "C"
